chatbot_metadata.name: Hospital FAQ Chatbot Knowledge Base
chatbot_metadata.intended_use: Conversational AI knowledge base for hospital website & messaging channels
chatbot_metadata.system_prompt:
You are an official Hospital FAQ Assistant. Your role is to provide accurate, verified information about hospital services, clinic timetables, location, and contacts. Strictly follow these guardrails:
1. NEVER give medical diagnoses, symptom assessments, or prescribe medications.
2. In an emergency, immediately instruct the user to seek emergency care or call the verified emergency number.
3. If any detail (hours, fees, doctor availability, appointment slots) is unverified or missing, state that you cannot confirm it from current approved records and refer them to official hospital contacts.
4. Be compassionate, concise, and professional.

safety_guardrails.medical_diagnosis_rule: The assistant cannot diagnose illnesses or advise on medications. Always refer to a qualified medical clinician.
safety_guardrails.emergency_rule: Direct users experiencing life-threatening symptoms to emergency services immediately.
safety_guardrails.unconfirmed_information_policy: When a visitor asks about information that is missing, outdated, conflicting, or not approved, the chatbot must not guess. It should state that it cannot confirm the answer and direct the visitor to the hospital's verified contact channel.
safety_guardrails.approved_fallback_response: “I’m unable to confirm that information from the hospital’s current approved information. Please contact the hospital directly for confirmation.”
unconfirmed_triggers: Clinic day or opening time not listed in the approved schedule.
Service or specialist not included in the current service directory.
Unconfirmed consultation fees, test prices, or insurance arrangements.
Unverified phone numbers, addresses, or emergency contacts.
Conflicting clinic schedules or expired documents.
Availability of a doctor, medicine, test, bed, or appointment in real time.

contacts.emergency_contact: [Enter verified number and hours of operation]
contacts.operational_note: Do not invent contact details. Test all telephone numbers and links before publishing them. If no emergency number has been confirmed, the chatbot must not make one up.

intents.description: Triggered when a user expresses an urgent medical crisis or life-threatening situation.
intents.response_text: If you or someone nearby is experiencing a medical emergency, please seek immediate emergency care. Call our emergency contact at [Enter verified number and hours of operation] or proceed immediately to the nearest Emergency Department. Do not wait for chatbot replies.

intents.description: Triggered when a user asks for medical diagnosis, symptom checks, or prescriptions.
intents.response_text: I cannot provide clinical diagnoses, interpret symptoms, or suggest medications. Please schedule an appointment or visit the General Outpatient Clinic to consult with a qualified physician.

intents.description: Triggered when a user asks what general services or facilities the hospital offers.
intents.response_text: The hospital offers the following approved services: General outpatient consultations and assessment., Emergency assessment and stabilization, if the hospital operates an emergency unit., Inpatient admission and ward care, where available., Maternal health services, including antenatal and postnatal care, if offered., Child health and immunization services, according to the hospital's approved programme., Laboratory investigations listed in the hospital's service directory., Pharmacy services and dispensing of prescribed medicines, where available., Minor procedures and wound care, if provided., Health education and preventive-care services., Referral to specialist services or other facilities when a service is unavailable.

intents.description: Triggered when a user asks for clinic timetables, days, or hours.
intents.response_text: Please specify the clinic or department name (e.g. Antenatal, Paediatric, Dental, Surgical, Outpatient) to check its timetable.

intents.description: Triggered when a user asks for address, directions, or parking.
intents.response_text: Address: [Enter verified street address], [Enter town or city], [Enter state]. Directions: [Enter verified directions].

intents.description: Triggered when a user asks how to call, email, or reach the hospital.
intents.response_text: Main Phone: 07014678906; Appointment Line: [Enter number, if separate]; Email: eleriuseastsunsam@gmail.com; Website: [Enter official website URL].

intents.description: Triggered when information is missing, unverified, contradictory, or unapproved.
intents.response_text: “I’m unable to confirm that information from the hospital’s current approved information. Please contact the hospital directly for confirmation.”

faq_knowledge_base.question: What services does the hospital offer?
sample_user_queries: What services do you offer?
What medical services are available?
What kind of treatments can I get here?
Do you do lab tests and surgery?
faq_knowledge_base.approved_answer: The hospital provides general outpatient consultations, emergency assessment and stabilization, inpatient ward care, maternal health (antenatal & postnatal care), child health and immunization, laboratory investigations, pharmacy dispensing, minor surgical procedures and wound care, health education, and specialist referrals.
faq_knowledge_base.answer_rule: List only services present in the approved service directory.

faq_knowledge_base.question: Which days does the antenatal clinic hold?
sample_user_queries: Which days does the antenatal clinic hold?
When is antenatal clinic open?
What days can pregnant women come for checkups?
Is antenatal clinic open on Monday?
faq_knowledge_base.approved_answer: The Antenatal Clinic operates on Tuesday and Thursday. (Please note: this is an example schedule for testing and should be confirmed with the hospital).
faq_knowledge_base.answer_rule: Return the verified antenatal clinic days. If not confirmed, say so.

faq_knowledge_base.question: What time does the paediatric clinic start?

faq_knowledge_base.approved_answer: Operating hours for the Paediatric Clinic are currently not confirmed in our system. Please contact the hospital directly to confirm start and closing times.
faq_knowledge_base.answer_rule: Return verified hours. If missing, direct the visitor to the hospital.

For urgent medical emergencies, call [Enter verified number and hours of operation].

faq_knowledge_base.question: Can you tell me what illness I have?
sample_user_queries: Can you tell me what illness I have?
What is wrong with me?
I have stomach pain and headache, what disease is it?
Can you prescribe medication for my cough?
Diagnose my symptoms
faq_knowledge_base.approved_answer: I am an automated hospital assistant and cannot provide medical diagnoses, interpret symptoms, or prescribe treatments. Please consult a qualified doctor or healthcare professional at our hospital for personal medical evaluation.
faq_knowledge_base.answer_rule: Explain that the FAQ assistant cannot diagnose and advise contacting a qualified clinician.

faq_knowledge_base.question: I may be having a medical emergency. What should I do?
sample_user_queries: I may be having a medical emergency. What should I do?
I am having severe chest pain!
Help, someone collapsed!
Heavy bleeding, what do I do?
Emergency!
faq_knowledge_base.approved_answer: If you or someone nearby is experiencing a medical emergency, seek immediate emergency medical care. Contact the hospital emergency line at [Enter verified number and hours of operation] or proceed directly to the nearest Emergency Department. Do not rely on an online chatbot for emergency situations.
faq_knowledge_base.answer_rule: Display the hospital-approved emergency instruction and verified contact details; do not attempt AI diagnosis.

maintenance_rules: A designated hospital staff member must approve the service directory and clinic timetable.
Record the date each schedule was last reviewed and who approved it.
Update the knowledge base whenever clinic days, hours, services, or contacts change.
Remove or archive superseded documents so old information cannot be retrieved.
Test common questions after every update.
Do not include patient records or confidential internal documents in the public FAQ knowledge base.

Hospital representative has tested and signed off the chatbot information.

preamble.title: HOSPITAL SERVICES & FAQ REFERENCE
preamble.subtitle: Sample knowledge-base document for a hospital website chatbot
preamble.disclaimer: IMPORTANT — SAMPLE DATA ONLY. This document contains illustrative hospital information generated for chatbot development. It does not describe a verified real hospital. Replace or confirm every service, department, clinic day, opening hour, address, and contact detail with information approved by the hospital before using it with the public. Example schedules below must not be treated as actual clinic schedules.

Inpatient admission and ward care, where available.
Maternal health services, including antenatal and postnatal care, if offered.
Child health and immunization services, according to the hospital's approved programme.
Laboratory investigations listed in the hospital's service directory.
Pharmacy services and dispensing of prescribed medicines, where available.
Minor procedures and wound care, if provided.
Health education and preventive-care services.
Referral to specialist services or other facilities when a service is unavailable.
